findings.claim: The change records task-6 retained PNG evidence as required runtime artifacts but the diff does not add those PNG bodies, so a clean checkout of this diff cannot satisfy the 23-artifact hash requirement.
findings.evidence: The task-6 receipt lists retained PNG artifacts at lines 52, 60, and 68, while the diff only adds the task-6 XML files and JSON receipt; the packet inventory also states those five task-6 artifacts are `git-index-tracked=false | pending-in-this-change=true`, and the blocking termination condition requires `all 23 retained artifact hashes` to pass.
findings.suggested_fix: Stage and include the three task-6 PNG artifacts (`task-6-current-android-runtime.png`, `task-6-current-android-capability-denial.png`, and `task-6-current-ios-runtime.png`) in the final diff/commit, or remove the receipt claims and verifier requirements.
